newsitem.title: UK: 600 Group down on H1 profit statement.
newsitem.headline: 600 Group down on H1 profit statement.

text.p: Shares of machine tools firm 600 Group Plc fell on Monday on the back of a dull trading statement coupled with first-half results, analysts said.
The shares -- which rose sharply in the year to June, having been trading at less than 80p in June 1995 -- dropped 17p to 249-1/2 by 1514 GMT in volume of 323,035 shares.
"The statement is slightly disappointing, but I don't think the figures themselves were too disappointing," said one analyst, who declined to be named.
"In the past, they had been very upbeat with the statement, while this time it was lukewarm,"
Chairman Michael Wright said in a statement the UK market had picked up after a quiet summer.

"The UK market has been fairly quiet during the summer, but enquiry rates are now increasing and we anticipate continued growth during the second half of this financial year and into next year," he said.

600 Group pre-tax profit before pension credit for the six months ending September 30 rose 66 percent to 5.1 million stg from 3.0 million stg in the same period last year. It raised its interim dividend to 1.5p from 0.75p.
